title: Invisible Love
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A boys' love anthology. In the main story Inori always takes his love troubles to his patient friend Senou, until he starts seeing Senou differently. Other stories include a clothing-store worker drawn to a new coworker with a troubled past, and a reunion eight years after graduation between a man now working at a gay host club and his former school crush.
life_message: Love is often closer than it looks, in the friend who has quietly been there all along.
